publisherFailure.step: Verify all platforms and publish the complete release
publisherFailure.phase: Post-upload GET release before asset validation and final publication PATCH

paymentRecoveryCIGates.rerunScope: Failed publisher only; native platform gates reused from unchanged source in attempt 1

entrances.network: configured proxy with normal TLS verification

publisherRetry.firstAttemptError: UND_ERR_SOCKET on post-upload GET releases/{id}; draft remained unpublished

requirements.orderWaiting: Automatic bounded polling; PAID with pending business order never grants rights; retains original quote.
requirements.immediateFocusCheck: Native focus, visible page, BFCache return and online wake start or join the original-order check.
requirements.accountAndFeatureRefresh: Confirmed order requires fresh same-owner account and remote verification of profile-download and watermark-free-video; failures retain pending reference.
requirements.restartRecovery: Order/account IDs written to existing OS encrypted credentials before exposing checkout; isolate by endpoint and owner; clear after refresh success.
requirements.oldClientBoundary: v2.0.22 and v2.0.23 require the new installer. Web return neither updates an installed client nor guarantees launch; absent old local references cannot be recreated retroactively.

publicationNotes: v2.0.24 was never published or deployed. Its immutable tag remains unchanged; v2.0.25 reran every acceptance gate.
Production DMG detach retries only explicit exit16 Resource busy, without forced unmount; exhausted preparation stops before replacement.
Hidden payment GUI disables background throttling; automatic polling wait allows scheduling margin. The production polling interval is unchanged.

Production checks are anonymous and read-only. Local and CI fixtures verify signed-in recovery, entitlement refresh and installed replacement/relaunch; no new real charge or production entitlement grant was performed.
Local direct github.com download checks timed out; public release checks passed through the existing configured proxy with normal TLS verification.
